conf.description: Palo Alto NGFW Config log (syslog-csv, PAN-OS 10.2/11.1), direct route: cribl-pack mechanism implemented natively per brief rule 3 (no Packs installed). Quote-aware CSV split of the 20 documented positional columns (before/after-change-detail carry raw XML that routinely contains embedded commas, so a naive split-on-comma regex would corrupt them - unlike this map's simpler CSV log types), event.outcome normalization off result, source.ip/domain branch on host by value shape, and secret-node redaction in the change-detail XML per recommendations.direct.cribl.

conf.comment: paloalto-ngfw / config / syslog-csv. Uses serde type:csv (quote-aware), NOT the positional regex_extract this map's other PAN-OS CSV logs use, because before/after-change-detail carry raw configuration XML that commonly contains embedded commas inside quoted CSV fields - a naive [^,]* split would truncate them. Column order is the documented 20-field PAN-OS Config CSV schema; vsys_name is a later-PAN-OS addition, left undefined on shorter rows rather than erroring. Only Succeeded/Failed collapse to ECS event.outcome; Submitted/Unauthorized become 'unknown' with the raw value preserved in panw.panos.config.result so dashboards do not undercount denied changes. host routes to source.* (never host.*) - the admin's client address, not the firewall - same collision the CEF shost row documents. Order: csv parse -> eval (ORIGINAL names) -> rename -> mask.

functions.description: why quote-aware CSV, the result-vocabulary gap, and the host/host.* collision
quote-aware split of the 20 documented PAN-OS Config CSV columns, positionally named; quoting protects before/after_change_detail's embedded commas
normalize result to event.outcome while preserving the raw vocabulary, branch host to source.ip vs source.domain by value shape, tag the dataset - all from ORIGINAL field names before rename
batch rename every clean-named mapped/custom column; result is fully consumed by the eval above and left as a raw duplicate alongside its panw.panos.config.result custom copy
redact password/hash/secret/api-key XML nodes in the change-detail blobs and in _raw where the same text still sits verbatim, per recommendations.direct.cribl's explicit redaction instruction
Re-nest flat dotted keys (data-maps canonical step)
